text.body:
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ । śrībhairava uvāca । adhunā devi vakṣyāmi lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya te । kavacaṃ mantragarbhaṃ ca vajrapañjarakākhyayā ॥ 1॥
śrīvajrapañjaraṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutam । rahasyaṃ sarvadevānāṃ sādhakānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ॥ 2॥
yaṃ dhṛtvā bhagavān devaḥ prasīdati paraḥ pumān । yasya dhāraṇamātreṇa brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ॥ 3॥
īśvaro'haṃ śivo bhīmo vāsavo'pi divaspatiḥ । sūryastejonidhirdevi candrarmāstārakeśvaraḥ ॥ 4॥
vāyuśca balavāṃlloke varuṇo yādasāmpatiḥ । kubero'pi dhanādhyakṣo dharmarājo yamaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥ 5॥
yaṃ dhṛtvā sahasā viṣṇuḥ saṃhariṣyati dānavān । jaghāna rāvaṇādīṃśca kiṃ vakṣye'hamataḥ param ॥ 6॥
kavacasyāsya subhage kathito'yaṃ muniḥ śivaḥ । triṣṭup chando devatā ca lakṣmīnārāyaṇo mataḥ ॥ 7॥
ramā bījaṃ parā śaktistāraṃ kīlakamīśvari । bhogāpavargasiddhyarthaṃ viniyoga iti smṛtaḥ ॥ 8॥
oṃ asya śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇakavacasya śivaḥ ṛṣiḥ । triṣṭup chandaḥ । śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇa devatā । śrīṃ bījaṃ । hrīṃ śaktiḥ । oṃ kīlakaṃ । bhogāpavargasiddhyarthe pāṭhe viniyogaḥ । atha dhyānam । pūrṇenduvadanaṃ pītavasanaṃ kamalāsanam । lakṣmyā śritaṃ caturbāhuṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ bhaje ॥ 9॥
atha kavacam । oṃ vāsudevo'vatu me mastakaṃ saśiroruham । hrīṃ lalāṭaṃ sadā pātu lakṣmīviṣṇuḥ samantataḥ ॥ 10॥
hsauḥ netre'vatāllakṣmīgovindo jagatāṃ patiḥ । hrīṃ nāsāṃ sarvadā pātu lakṣmīdāmodaraḥ prabhuḥ ॥ 11॥
śrīṃ mukhaṃ satataṃ pātu devo lakṣmītrivikramaḥ । lakṣmī kaṇṭhaṃ sadā pātu devo lakṣmījanārdanaḥ ॥ 12॥
nārāyaṇāya bāhū me pātu lakṣmīgadāgrajaḥ । namaḥ pārśvau sadā pātu lakṣmīnandaikanandanaḥ ॥ 13॥
aṃ āṃ iṃ īṃ pātu vakṣo oṃ lakṣmītripureśvaraḥ । uṃ ūṃ ṛṃ ṝṃ pātu kukṣiṃ hrīṃ lakṣmīgaruḍadhvajaḥ ॥ 14॥
lṛṃ lṝṃ eṃ aiṃ pātu pṛṣṭhaṃ hsauḥ lakṣmīnṛsiṃhakaḥ । oṃ auṃ aṃ aḥ pātu nābhiṃ hrīṃ lakṣmīviṣṭaraśravaḥ ॥ 15॥
kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ gudaṃ pātu śrīṃ lakṣmīkaiṭabhāntakaḥ । caṃ chaṃ jaṃ jhaṃ pātu śiśrnaṃ lakṣmī lakṣmīśvaraḥ prabhuḥ ॥ 16॥
ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ kaṭiṃ pātu nārāyaṇāya nāyakaḥ । taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ pātu corū namo lakṣmījagatpatiḥ ॥ 17॥
paṃ phaṃ baṃ bhaṃ pātu jānū oṃ hrīṃ lakṣmīcaturbhujaḥ । yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ pātu jaṅghe hsauḥ lakṣmīgadādharaḥ ॥ 18॥
śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ pātu gulphau hrīṃ śrīṃ lakṣmīrathāṅgabhṛt । laṃ kṣaḥ pādau sadā pātu mūlaṃ lakṣmīsahasrapāt ॥ 19॥
ṅaṃ ñaṃ ṇaṃ naṃ maṃ me pātu lakṣmīśaḥ sakalaṃ vapuḥ । indro māṃ pūrvataḥ pātu vahnirvahnau sadāvatu ॥ 20॥
yamo māṃ dakṣiṇe pātu nairṛtyāṃ nirṛtiśca mām । varuṇaḥ paścime'vyānmāṃ vāyavye'vatu māṃ marut ॥ 21॥
uttare dhanadaḥ pāyādaiśānyāmīśvaro'vatu । vajraśaktidaṇḍakhaḍga pāśayaṣṭidhvajāṅkitāḥ ॥ 22॥
saśūlāḥ sarvadā pāntu digīśāḥ paramārthadāḥ । anantaḥ pātvadho nityamūrdhve brahmāvatācca mām ॥ 23॥
daśadikṣu sadā pātu lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ । prabhāte pātu māṃ viṣṇurmadhyāhne vāsudevakaḥ ॥ 24॥
dāmodaro'vatāt sāyaṃ niśādau narasiṃhakaḥ । saṅkarṣaṇo'rdharātre'vyāt prabhāte'vyāt trivikramaḥ ॥ 25॥
aniruddhaḥ sarvakālaṃ viśvaksenaśca sarvataḥ । raṇe rājakule dyute vivāde śatrusaṅkaṭe oṃ hrīṃ hsauḥ hrīṃ śrīṃ mūlaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇo'vatu ॥ 26॥
oṃoṃoṃraṇarājacaurariputaḥ pāyācca māṃ keśavaḥ hrīṃhrīṃhrīṃhahhāhsauḥ hsahsauḥ vahnervatānmādhavaḥ । hrīṃhrīṃhrīṃjalaparvatāgnibhayataḥ pāyādananto vibhuḥ śrīṃśrīṃśrīṃśaśaśālalaṃ pratidinaṃ lakṣmīdhavaḥ pātu mām ॥ 27॥
itīdaṃ kavacaṃ divyaṃ vajrapañjarakābhidham । lakṣmīnārāyaṇasyeṣṭaṃ caturvargaphalapradam ॥ 28॥
sarvasaubhāgyanilayaṃ sarvasārasvatapradam । lakṣmīsaṃvananaṃ tatvaṃ paramārtharasāyanam ॥ 29॥
mantragarbhaṃ jagatsāraṃ rahasyaṃ tridivaukasām । daśavāraṃ paṭhedrātrau ratānte vaiṣṇavottamaḥ ॥ 30॥
svapne varapradaṃ paśyellakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ sudhīḥ । trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennityaṃ kavacaṃ manmukhoditam ॥ 31॥
sa yāti paramaṃ dhāma vaiṣṇavaṃ vaiṣṇaveśvaraḥ । mahācīnapadastho'pi yaḥ paṭhedātmacintakaḥ ॥ 32॥
ānandapūritastūrṇaṃ labhed mokṣaṃ sa sādhakaḥ । gandhāṣṭakena vilikhedravau bhūrje japanmanum ॥ 33॥
pītasūtreṇa saṃveṣṭya sauvarṇenātha veṣṭayet । dhārayedguṭikāṃ mūrdhni lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ smaran ॥ 34॥
raṇe ripun vijityāśu kalyāṇī gṛhamāviśet । vandhyā vā kākavandhyā vā mṛtavatsā ca yāṅganā ॥ 35॥
sā badhnīyān kaṇṭhadeśe labhet putrāṃścirāyuṣaḥ । gurupadeśato dhṛtvā guruṃ dhyātvā manuṃ japan ॥ 36॥
varṇalakṣapuraścaryā phalamāpnoti sādhakaḥ । bahunoktena kiṃ devi kavacasyāsya pārvati ॥ 37॥
vinānena na siddhiḥ syānmantrasyāsya maheśvari । sarvāgamarahasyāḍhyaṃ tatvāt tatvaṃ parāt param ॥ 38॥
abhaktāya na dātavyaṃ kucailāya durātmane । dīkṣitāya kulīnāya svaśiṣyāya mahātmane ॥ 39॥
mahācīnapadasthāya dātavyaṃ kavacottamam । guhyaṃ gopyaṃ mahādevi lakṣmīnārāyaṇapriyam । vajrapañjarakaṃ varma gopanīyaṃ svayonivat ॥ 40॥
॥ iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye lakṣmīnārāyaṇakavacaṃ sampūrṇam ॥
